about: The collecta of the formulary “Most Holy Name of Jesus” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O God, Who didst appoint Thine only-begotten Son to be the Savior of mankind and didst command that He be called Jesus, mercifully grant that we who venerate His holy name on earth may also rejoice in beholding Him in heaven. Through the same our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
